content.text: No non-solicitation or no-hire obligation binds us anywhere in the agreement, and § 12.3 affirmatively confirms this.

input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-inducement covenant binding Meridian Fieldworks. Searches for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "hire", and "employ" return no restrictive covenant; the only hits are § 12.3, which expressly preserves our freedom to hire any person responding to general recruitment and confirms we have given no no-hire commitment, and unrelated references to Vendor personnel (§§ 3.1, 14.2, 30.1) that impose no hiring restriction on us. This matches the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is needed.
